title: Qwen3.8 Max now ranked as the best overall model by agentic index
summary: The article reports that Qwen3.8 Max has achieved the top ranking on Artificial Analysis' agentic index, which evaluates models on real-world agentic tasks like tool use and multi-step reasoning. This signals a shift in the competitive landscape, with open-weight models challenging proprietary leaders. The discussion on Hacker News highlights community reactions, benchmarks, and implications for AI development.
